title: iberis pruitii subsp. granatensis
intro: Iberis pruitii subsp. granatensis, commonly known as Candytuft, is a flowering plant species in the Brassicaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as respiratory problems, fever, and digestive disorders, due to its potential health benefits. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions like anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents present in Candytuft include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic effects.
